name: Old City (Lal Ghat)
tagline: Lakeside heart below the City Palace
description: The historic core along Lake Pichola beside the City Palace and Jagdish Temple, threaded with narrow lanes of guesthouses, rooftop cafes and shops. The most atmospheric and central base for sights, though streets are tight, busy and often congested with traffic.
bestFor: Travellers wanting lake views and sights within walking distance

name: Hanuman Ghat
description: Across the lake from Lal Ghat on the western bank, a quieter bohemian pocket of guesthouses, yoga and art spaces with fine views back toward the City Palace. Calmer and more relaxed than the east bank while still an easy walk over the footbridge to the center.
bestFor: Longer-stay nomads wanting calm, yoga and lake views near center

name: Ambrai / Amet Haveli area
description: The northwestern lakeshore near Ambrai Ghat and Chand Pol, known for heritage havelis, waterfront restaurants and classic views of the Lake Palace. Slightly removed from the densest lanes, it offers a scenic, calmer setting while remaining close to the old city core.
bestFor: Visitors wanting iconic lake views and heritage hotels near the core

name: Fateh Sagar Lake area
tagline: Open lakeside promenade north of center
description: The residential district around Fateh Sagar Lake north of the old city, with a breezy promenade, cafes and easier roads. More modern and spacious with local eateries and better connectivity, it suits those wanting calm, air and value over the crowded tourist lanes.
bestFor: Nomads wanting space, calm and value with modern amenities
